# Ultimate Thumbnail Maker

> Ultimate Thumbnail Maker is an Android graphic design application for content creators, vloggers, and gaming streamers to create high-CTR YouTube thumbnails, channel art, and banners directly on mobile devices.

## Core Facts
- Name: Ultimate Thumbnail Maker
- Package Name: com.sk.thumbnailmaker
- Developer: Nilesh Jain
- Platform: Android (Google Play Store)
- Price: Free (Ad-supported)
- Primary Use: YouTube Video Thumbnails (1280x720, 16:9), Gaming Thumbnails, Social Media Banners

## Key Features
- Niche Templates: Pre-built templates for gaming, travel vlogs, tech reviews, podcasts, and video tutorials
- Typography Engine: Custom bold fonts, 3D text extrusions, neon glow, and high-contrast color strokes optimized for mobile viewing
- Cutout & Background Removal: Built-in subject isolation to cut out creators, streamer facecams, or game characters
- Privacy & Local Processing: 100% on-device image rendering without uploading user photos to external servers
- High-Resolution Export: Direct render to Android gallery for upload into YouTube Studio
